standard: GA 01 tokens remain in certified source-token order. A token may move only to an unoccupied comparison row selected by global monotonic alignment against Vaticanus, Byzantine, and papyrus Greek; normalized identity or similarity of at least 0.9 is required. Nomina-sacra comparison expansion is lookup-only. Every proposed move must preserve strict row order for the complete GA 01 verse. Occupied rows, ambiguous low-similarity forms, and genuine variants are never overwritten.
